## NSXL for Windows 1.3.9

**Quick menu**
- The quick menu now opens on the screen your game (or NSXL) is on. It used to open on whichever screen the mouse pointer was on, so with a second monitor it often opened on the wrong screen, behind the second-screen artwork, out of sight.
- In Xbox mode, NSXL no longer minimises Windows' own Xbox mode shell when it's trying to show the menu.
- The log now says which screen the menu opened on.

**Focus**
- If NSXL can't take focus back after a few tries, it waits a minute instead of retrying over and over.
